subject: Tri-party co-sell demo: Orbit Systems + AWS + Redwood - runway resync
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@orbit-systems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kate Bennett <kate.bennett@amazon.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria@orbit-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Orbit x Redwood x AWS - co-sell demo window + draft agenda

Hi Jordan + Kate,

Thanks for agreeing to partner on a joint marketplace demo for Orbit Systems next week. We want the session to be technical enough for the SI folks and product-focused for the buyer — target audience: Platform Engineering + Procurement.

Proposed objectives:
- 20 min: Orbit product overview and value props for cloud-native inference
- 25 min: Redwood technical deep-dive (latency/cost SLOs, dedicated vs hosted)
- 15 min: AWS marketplace + procurement flow (what buyers see)
- 10 min: Q&A / next steps

We can be flexible on time. Here are a few slot options (all PDT):
- Tue 31 Aug: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 1 Sep: 10:00–11:00 or 16:00–17:00

Attachments: Orbit_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda) and runbook-draft.md (ops checklist).

Are you able to confirm one of the slots? If not, suggest alternatives and we will adapt.

Best,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
GTM Lead, Orbit Systems

Sanjay — appreciate the clear agenda. All three internal of us are aligned on scope. A couple quick asks before we lock:
- Can you share the primary buyer personas (titles/teams) so we tailor the opening deck?
- We prefer the session run under 60 minutes; the 10:00 PDT slots are best for Redwood ops.

Our availability (PT):
- Tue 31 Aug: 10:00–11:00 OK (preferred)
- Wed 1 Sep: 08:00–09:00 *possible* (Western US AM)

Kate — do you and the AWS marketplace team have a preference? If 31 Aug doesn't work for AWS, we can propose a fallback on Thu 2 Sep at 08:00 PT.

Thanks — I'll draft a short run-of-show if you confirm a slot.

— Jordan

Thanks Jordan and Sanjay — I dug into our marketplace calendar and we have a conflict on Tue 31 Aug (global partner townhall). Wed 1 Sep 16:00 PDT will hit APAC late evening for a couple of key AWS SAs who need to be on the call.

Two proposals from our side:
1) Move to Thu 2 Sep at 08:00 PDT — aligns with Redwood's fallback mentioned and keeps APAC reasonable in the early evening.
2) Keep Wed 1 Sep but split the session: APAC-friendly timeslot for APAC audience and a replay for NA buyers (complicates ops).

I'm leaning to option 1 (Thu 2 Sep 08:00 PDT). If we lock Thu 2 Sep I can route an AWS Marketplace rep and the SI onboarding SA.

Kate Bennett
Sr. Partner Programs Manager, AWS Marketplace
